changes: Nested finally always attempts the global closure observer even when reference stat/read/save fails. Only a fixed UNAVAILABLE_STOP_REQUIRED reference is retained; unavailable reference stops verdict and final metadata.

Global closure requires exact dictionary fields and strict nonnegative integer zero counts. The fixed all-database/all-role/all-tag proof records observation completion, type validity and absent booleans even on malformed or throwing observations, without arbitrary values.
Three added regression methods cover reference stat/read/save failure, malformed/throwing observer metadata and blocked verdict/native observations, with an admitted typed-zero positive.
